Implement the failed-payment reminder worker from this ticket. It sends an email with an existing payment link; it doesn't calculate totals or collect a payment.

Ticket: Customers who abandon a failed card attempt should receive one reminder after 30 minutes. The scheduler already publishes payment.reminder_due with an orderId. The handler should look up the order, skip orders that have since been paid or cancelled, and otherwise call the existing reminder mailer. Keep the existing email copy.

Here's the production sequence that prompted the ticket clarification:

09:30:00 worker-a received payment.reminder_due order=ord_812
09:30:01 worker-a mailer completed
09:30:01 worker-a connection closed before acknowledgement
09:30:08 worker-b received payment.reminder_due order=ord_812
09:30:09 worker-b mailer completed

Support got two copies forwarded by the customer. The broker team says this delivery pattern is expected and won't be changed. We also have other scheduled emails for the same order, so don't accidentally suppress a shipping update because a payment reminder has already happened. The scheduler and mailer interfaces are already present; this task is the handler and whatever durable bookkeeping it needs. Make sure the approach still works if two consumers receive the reminder close together, and explain how recovery works if the process dies partway through.
